workflow_steps.title: Join population attributes to census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Attach the observed total population attributes to the corresponding census-tract polygons.
workflow_steps.instructions: Join the census-tract vector from input_1 with the population table from input_2 using the runtime-grounded common identifier fields. Preserve the tract geometries and population attributes. Do not assume or invent join-key names; use schema evidence at runtime.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate population and land area by tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Produce the final census-tract-level vector summary with total population and land area.
workflow_steps.instructions: Using the joined tract vector, retain one result per census tract and calculate land area from the valid polygon geometry in square metres using the source metric CRS. Retain the runtime-grounded total population attribute and tract identifier attributes. Do not invent field names; ground input and output fields from runtime schema evidence.
